 $\sec^{- 1}\left\lbrack \frac{1}{4}\sum_{k = 0}^{10}\mspace{2mu} sec\left( \frac{7\pi}{12} + \frac{k\pi}{12} \right)sec\left( \frac{7\pi}{12} + (k + 1)\frac{\pi}{2} \right) \right\rbrack$
Given exp
$= \sec^{- 1}\left\lbrack - \frac{1}{4}\sum_{k = 0}^{10}\mspace{2mu} sec\left( \frac{7\pi}{12} + \frac{k\pi}{12} \right)cosec\left( \frac{7\pi}{12} + \frac{k\pi}{2} \right) \right\rbrack$
$= \sec^{- 1}\left\lbrack - \frac{1}{4}\sum_{k = 0}^{10}\mspace{2mu}\frac{2}{sin\left( \frac{7\pi}{6} + k\pi \right)} \right\rbrack = \sec^{- 1}\left\lbrack - \frac{1}{2}\sum_{k = 0}^{10}\mspace{2mu}\frac{1}{( - 1)^{k + 1}sin\frac{\pi}{6}} \right\rbrack$
$= \sec^{- 1}\left( - \sum_{k = 0}^{10}\mspace{2mu}\frac{1}{( - 1)^{k + 1}} \right) = \sec^{- 1}(1) = 0$
